spans.s: † बीभ् बीभ्, or चीभ् चिभ्, i. 1, Ātm. To boast.
1. बीभत्स बीभत्स, an anomal. desider. probably of बाध्, Ātm. To be angry, to detest, Utt.

2. बीभत्स बीभत्स, i. e. बीभत्स + अ,
 I. m. Disgust, abhorrence.
 II. adj.
 1. Loathing, detesting.
 2. Loathful, Utt.

; Pañc. iii. d. 112.
 3. Mischievous, cruel.
 4. Envious.
 --Comp.
